summary: T3 (ics-import-t3) verified against acceptance criteria: POST /api/v1/calendars/:calendar_id/import-ics returns 201 for owner/manager/editor, non-enumerating 404 for viewer/free-busy-viewer/unrelated users, 400 with stable codes for wrong media type/empty/malformed/limit-exceeded input, 413 for oversized body (>1 MiB), Standard-tier rate limiting, and content-free structured logs. All 11 matching tests pass (10 integration + 1 rate-limiter classifier); command exited 0.
